limitations: Calling-thread CPU and allocated bytes are not whole-process CPU or retained heap/private commit.
Fresh-JVM first-query controls exclude VM startup and manifest construction; they are not whole-app launch times.
Constructed manifests and host identity/XML/native boundaries; no APK installer, remote Binder or Windows ART execution is claimed.
Package library isolation uses a constructed immutable graph and actual graph-to-ApplicationInfo generation; live XML/jar re-resolution remains unchanged in production.
Two JVMs per mode yield 14 steady samples per scenario; samples within each JVM are correlated. Cold controls use six ABBA rounds/12 fresh JVMs per mode per size.
All rejected prototype and cold outlier samples remain separate from final-source acceptance. Dedicated release budgets and full fork CI are still required.
